reference.title: Product A: Contraindications and Precautions
reference.shortdesc: Information on safety and contraindications for Product A.

section.title: Contraindications
section.p: Product A is contraindicated in patients with the following conditions:

ul.li: Known severe hypersensitivity to Product A or any of its excipients.
Severe baseline myelosuppression (absolute neutrophil count < 500/mm³ or platelet count < 50,000/mm³).
Severe hepatic impairment (total bilirubin > 3x upper limit of normal).

section.title: Precautions
section.p: Before administering Product A, consider the following safety precautions:

ul.li: Monitor complete blood counts (CBC) prior to initiating each cycle and routinely during treatment.
Assess for signs of febrile neutropenia or active systemic infection before each dose.
Monitor hepatic function tests and serum electrolyte levels during administration to assess for potential tumor lysis syndrome (TLS).
